items.heading: Rice and Beans with Stew Chicken
details: Key ingredients: rice, red beans, coconut milk, chicken, recado spice
Cook red beans until tender, then simmer rice in coconut milk with the beans.
Season chicken pieces with recado spice paste and brown them.
Simmer the chicken in a seasoned tomato-based sauce until tender.
Serve the coconut rice and beans alongside the stewed chicken.

items.heading: Garnaches
details: Key ingredients: corn tortillas, refried beans, cabbage, cheese, pickled onion
Fry small corn tortillas until crisp.
Spread a layer of refried beans on each tortilla.
Top with shredded cabbage, crumbled cheese and pickled onion.
Serve immediately while the tortillas are still crunchy.

items.heading: Rice and Beans
details: Ingredients: rice, vegetables or protein, onion/garlic, oil, seasoning and water/stock.
Cook the rice by absorption or steaming.
Sauté the other ingredients separately, combine and season to taste.

items.heading: Stew Chicken
details: Ingredients: vegetables, protein or legumes, onion, garlic, stock, herbs/spices and salt.
Sauté aromatics, add the remaining ingredients and stock, simmer gently until tender, then adjust seasoning.

items.heading: Fry Jacks
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, flour or starch, aromatics/spices, salt and frying oil.
Mix and shape into portions, heat oil to medium-hot, fry until crisp and golden, then drain.
